intent: For each pasted row, match the description to an exact catalogue product (brand/series/model/kind + given properties), look up the requesting employee's store same-day availability, and emit the tab-separated RowID/SKU/in_stock/match table in input order.
success_criteria: Output is tab-separated with header line: RowID\tSKU\tin_stock\tmatch
Rows emitted in the same order as input: FK775, WgE71, KQHmi, UUzXw, T4swK
A row with no exact catalogue product has empty SKU and empty in_stock and match=false
in_stock equals store_inventory.available_today_quantity for the requesting employee's store_id
match=true only when an exact catalogue product exists AND in_stock >= requested quantity
refs include the record_path of every matched SKU

args: WITH matched AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model AND pk.product_kind_name = :kind AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'machine_type' AND p.property_value_text = :machine_type) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'voltage_v' AND p.property_value_text = :voltage_v)) SELECT m.product_sku, m.record_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS in_stock FROM matched m LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = m.product_sku AND si.store_id = :store_id;

agents_md_constraints.rule: id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
